notes.title: October 25th 2020 Update
notes.notes:
October 25th 2020 Update:

Full in-game controller support added. This means that the Dash Kill, opening tutorial, NPC interactions and pause menu now works with the controller. The only current exception for controller support is the opening menu screen.

notes.title: October 23rd 2020 Update
notes.notes:
October 23rd 2020 Update (Steam achievements, minor bug fixes and changes)

38 new Steam Achievements added to the game.
Player can no longer move during mini in-game cutscenes.
Slime sprite remastered.

notes.title: October 17 2020 Update
notes.notes:
October 17 2020 Update (Minor bug fixes and changes):

Dashkilling in and out of a locked room no longer locks you out.
Known instances of Dashkill freezing patched.
Added ability to initiate Dashkill manually rather than waiting for the timer to run out.
'Escape' button now allows you to exit pause menu.
Dialogue notification sound made less jarring.
Spamming buttons in main menu no longer breaks the game.
